frame_convention.heading_deg: CCW from +X in [-180, 180], exact racing-line horizontal tangent
frame_convention.bank_deg: Right-hand roll around +Forward tangent T: +bank tilts road normal toward +Right (inward on right turns), -bank tilts toward +Left (inward on left turns)
frame_convention.curv_1pm: Signed horizontal curvature of racing_xy (+left CCW, -right CW)
frame_convention.racing_offset_m: Signed lateral offset along banked surface (+left = -Right_vec, -right = +Right_vec): P_race_3d = C_3d - racing_offset_m * Right_banked
frame_convention.ribbon_basis_python: h, pt, bk = radians(heading_deg), radians(pitch_deg), radians(bank_deg); T = Vector((cos(pt)*cos(h), cos(pt)*sin(h), sin(pt))); R0 = Vector((sin(h), -cos(h), 0.0)); U0 = Vector((-sin(pt)*cos(h), -sin(pt)*sin(h), cos(pt))); R = cos(bk)*R0 - sin(bk)*U0; U = sin(bk)*R0 + cos(bk)*U0
